title: Article VII of the Bylaws: The Revolvement Cycle and Preferred Dividend of the Membership and Patronage Equity Classes
content:
**Section 1.** Equity retained under Membership and Patronage Equity is returned to the member on the board's revolvement cycle. Each class carries its own cycle in whole fiscal years, its own annual pool as a percentage of unrevolved equity, and its own order of payment.

**Section 2.** The figures of each class are these.

| Class | Fiscal years an allocation must stand before it revolves | Order in which unrevolved allocations are paid back | Share of unrevolved equity revolved in one year, per cent | Annual dividend on preferred equity, per cent | Class carries a dividend |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Associate Patron Account | 0 | not applicable | 0 | 0 | no |
| Class A Voting Membership | 12 | oldest allocation year first | 8 | 0 | no |
| Class B Preferred Equity Membership | 10 | oldest allocation year first | 10 | 4.5 | yes |
| Retained Patronage Certificate Holding | 15 | oldest allocation year first | 6 | 0 | no |
| Age Retirement Equity Membership | 12 | age of member, then oldest allocation year | 8 | 0 | no |
| Estate Retirement Equity Holding | 0 | paid in full on approval | 100 | 0 | no |

**Section 3.** One class only carries a dividend on preferred equity, at 4.5 per cent a year; on the other five the dividend column reads 0 and the class carries none.

**Section 4.** One class pays in full on approval rather than out of an annual pool, its pool column reading 100 per cent and its cycle 0 fiscal years. One class revolves nothing at all, its cycle and its pool both reading 0.

**Section 5, by way of illustration on hypothetical figures.** On a class whose cycle is 12 fiscal years, an allocation posted for a fiscal year becomes eligible once 12 whole fiscal years have run from that year. On a class whose pool is 8 per cent, unrevolved equity of 4000.00 yields a pool share of 320.00 for the year; on a class whose pool is 6 per cent the same equity yields 240.00.
